title: Hanford complete material balance receives append-only transparency proofs
summary: Current and prior release indexes plus the governed key registry remain included in a contract-specific append-only transparency tree whose inclusion proofs, consistency proof, tree size, and root digest can be independently checked. Denominator: One contract-specific transparency schema, twenty-two adversarial cases, seven valid or preservation routes, fifteen explicit rejections, and zero production log entries or proofs published.
